site.name: GFTV HelloEvents
meta.description: Find furmeets and furry conventions, and RSVP. By Global Furry Television.
language.modal.title: Choose a language
official.line: An official Global Furry Television website
official.domain-heading: Official GFTV sites end with globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address from the end, at the last dot before the first single slash. A site ending in anything else is not GFTV, even if the name appears earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The full list of official GFTV sites
official.secure-body: Look for a padlock, or https:// at the start of the address. Only share personal details on an official site over a secure connection.
update.label: Update
update.ready: A new version of GFTV HelloEvents is ready.
theme.title: Theme
theme.time-note: Light from {from} to {until} on this device's clock, dark otherwise. Now: {mode}.
home.meta-title: GFTV HelloEvents | Furmeets and furry conventions
home.title: Furmeets and furry conventions
home.lede: Find your next meet, see how many are going, and RSVP with your GFTV account.
home.empty: Nothing here yet. Check back soon.
event.missing-lede: It may have moved, or it is not public yet.
event.preview: Preview: this event is not public yet. Only editors can see it.
event.tier-max: One person can buy up to {count} of these.
event.country-needed: This is a cross-border event. Add your country of origin to your account to RSVP.
event.link-sign-in: Sign in to open this link.
event.link-country: Add your country of origin to your account to open this link.
event.online-for-attendees: The online link is shown to people going.
event.address-for-attendees: The street address is shown to people going.
event.for-meals: I only want to show up for the meal
event.full-meals-open: The event is full, but you can still come just for a meal.
event.volunteers-wanted: This convention is taking volunteers. Tick "I would like to volunteer" when you RSVP.
event.volunteer-benefit-earlier: Volunteered at our earlier convention? You get {benefit}.
event.fursuiter-hint: Lets the organisers plan for suiters: changing space, handlers and water.
event.volunteer-check: I would like to volunteer at this convention
event.volunteer-thanks: Thank you for volunteering at this convention.
event.volunteer-you-get: You volunteered at {convention}, so you get {benefit} here.
event.volunteer-you-get-earlier: You volunteered at our earlier convention, so you get {benefit} here.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.lede: That address does not lead anywhere on this site.
login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Use your HelloEvents account, or your GFTV staff account.
login.factor-lede: Confirm it is you with one of these.
login.help-totp: Open your authenticator app and type the six digit code for GFTV.
login.help-passkey: Use the passkey you made for this site. Your device will ask you to confirm.
login.help-telegram: Press Send me a code, then type the code the HelloEvents bot sends you.
login.help-backup: Type one of your backup codes. Each one works once.
setup.totp-help: Scan this with Google Authenticator or any authenticator app, then type the six digit code it shows.
setup.totp-manual: Or type this key into the app:
setup.totp-qr-label: QR code for your authenticator app
codes.file-heading: Backup codes for {site}. Each one works once.
account.signed-out-others: Every other session on this site is signed out.
account.country-lede: Cross-border events and conventions ask for it before you RSVP. Only you, and the organisers of those events, see it.
account.country-missing: You have not added your country of origin yet.
security.title: Security
security.totp-shared: Set up on your GFTV account at gftv.asia. Change it there.
security.telegram-pending: Press Start in Telegram, then come back to this page.
security.backup-left.one: {count} unused backup code from this site.
security.backup-left.other: {count} unused backup codes from this site.
security.password-lede: For your safety, type your password again.
manage.title: Manage events
manage.lede: Drafts and events with a release time in the future are seen by editors only.
manage.delete-lede: The event and its RSVP list are removed for good. To keep the record, set it to Cancelled instead.
manage.cancel-instead-hint: Cancelling keeps the event page up, marked as cancelled, keeps its RSVP list, and tells the people going.
manage.csv.name: Name
manage.contact-lede: Ask the people going how to reach them. Tick any you want, or add your own. Only this event's editors see what they give, on the attendee list.
manage.contact-add: Add a field of your own
manage.contact-custom-label: Your field {number}: what it asks for
manage.contact-custom-type: Your field {number}: what is typed in it
manage.contact-custom-placeholder: What it asks for, such as Email or Instagram
contact.legend: How the organisers can reach you
contact.hint.phone: With the country code, such as +65 9123 4567.
contact.hint.telegram: Such as @username: 5 to 32 letters, digits and underscores.
contact.hint.discord: Your username, such as fox.paws (not your display name).
contact.hint.text: Up to 200 characters, on one line.
contact.rule-any: Give at least one of these.
contact.rule-optional: Optional: fill in any you like.
contact.private: Only the event's organisers see these.
contact.required-any: Give at least one way to reach you.
contact.missing: The organisers ask how to reach you. Fill this in, then save it.
manage.status-meaning.draft: Only editors can see it. Set it to Published when it is ready to go live.
manage.status-meaning.published: Live: anyone can find it, from its release time if it has one.
manage.status-meaning.cancelled: Called off: the page says so and takes no RSVPs, and the people going are told.
manage.volunteers-convention-only: Only conventions take volunteers. Set Kind to Convention under Basics to use this.
manage.volunteer-sources-none: There are no other conventions yet. Once there is one, it can be picked here.
manage.hint.volunteerDiscount: Only the people an editor ticked as "Volunteered" in that convention's attendee list get it. A percentage is up to 100; an amount is in this event's currency. Applying it at checkout comes later: for now the event page tells them they have it.
manage.field.title: Title
manage.hint.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Left blank, it is made from the title. Changing it breaks links already shared.
manage.slug-taken: {link} is already used by another event. Add eight random characters to the end of it, or edit the link and try another.
manage.hint.organiserName: The GFTV team running it, or Other for anyone else.
manage.field.datesHidden: Dates to be announced: keep the dates off the public page
manage.field.addressAttendeesOnly: Show the street addresses and map links only to people going
manage.field.priceHidden: Hide the price: show "to be announced" publicly
manage.field.tiersEnabled: Sell tickets in tiers, each with its own name, price and benefits
manage.hint.tiers: For a paid event. The From and Up to prices then come from the tiers.
manage.tier-includes-none: No other tier (just its own benefits)
manage.field.tierMultiple: One person can buy more than one of this tier
manage.hint.tierCurrency: Blank: the event's currency. People buying this tier pay in this currency, and can upgrade only to tiers in the same currency. The price on event cards comes from the tiers in the event's own currency.
manage.hint.tierLimit: Once this many people hold the tier, it is sold out. This is on top of the event's own capacity. Leave blank for no limit.
manage.tier-display.full: List those benefits again in full
manage.hint.externalUrl: Tickets, the event's website, a group to join: the event page shows it as a button.
manage.field.crossBorder: Cross-border event: held outside Singapore, or drawing people from other countries
manage.hint.crossBorder: People must give their country of origin on their account to RSVP or open the link, and the attendee list shows where everyone is from. Ticked for a convention to start with.
manage.timetable-lede: What happens when, for the event page. It shows there once it has an item, except while the dates are to be announced. People going are told when it changes.
manage.field.timetableView: Show it on the event page as
manage.timetable-view.timeline: An itinerary: a timeline with a dot at each time of day and what happens then (no rooms or end times)
manage.timetable-view.grid: A timetable: a table with a column for each room, or a list (visitors can switch)
manage.rooms-lede: The timetable's columns, left to right: a hall, a panel room, a stage. A short tag such as "Level G" shows over the name. A meet in one place needs none.
manage.hint.itinerary: Each step is a time and what happens then, such as "12:00: Travel to the border". Times are in the event's time zone. A step lasts until the next one; the event page puts them in time order.
manage.hint.items: Times are in the event's time zone. An end earlier than the start is the next day (21:00 to 01:00). With no end, an item is shown as half an hour long. The event page puts the items in time order.
manage.field.fursuitersAsked: Ask people going whether they are fursuiters
manage.hint.fursuitersAsked: They can tick "I'm a fursuiter" when they RSVP, and change it until the event. The attendee list shows who did, with a count.
manage.field.volunteersWanted: Taking volunteers: people going can tick "I would like to volunteer"
manage.field.volunteerDiscountEnabled: Give a benefit to the people who volunteered at an earlier convention
manage.meals-lede: Tick the meals people can RSVP for on their own, instead of the whole event. Leave them all off to take RSVPs for the whole event only.
manage.hint.meals: Name your own, such as "High tea" or "Supper", up to five. People coming only for a meal do not take one of the event's spaces; give a meal a number of places to limit it, or leave Places blank for no limit.
manage.hint.mealElsewhere: For a meal away from the event, such as dinner at a restaurant after the meet. Paste a Google Maps link to fill in the place. Leave it off when the meal is at the event.
manage.hint.description: Write it in both English and Chinese; switch between them above. Format it as in Word. Pasted text keeps its formatting, and pasted pictures are copied into the gallery. Click a picture in the description to size or crop it.
manage.hint.times: Leave a time blank while it is to be confirmed: the event page shows the date alone. With no end date, the event ends on its start date.
manage.hint.mapsUrl: Paste a Google Maps link and the venue, street address, city and country fill in. Check them afterwards.
manage.hint.timezone: Where the event happens. The dates and times below are in this zone.
manage.hint.publishLocal: A published event stays hidden until this time, in the event time zone.
manage.hint.staffNotes: Editors only. Never shown on the public page.
manage.editor-empty-lede: Pick an event in the event list to edit it, or make a new one.
manage.autosave-lede: Changes save by themselves as soon as you leave a field.
manage.autosave.new: Saves by itself once it has a title, both descriptions and a start date (or Dates to be announced).
manage.autosave.leave-failed:
Your last change was not saved: {reason}

Leave without saving it?
manage.autosave.leave-new: This new event has not been saved yet. It needs a title, both descriptions and a start date. Leave without saving it?
manage.locations-empty: No locations yet. An online-only event needs none.
manage.location-filled: Filled in from Google Maps. Check the details.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.bad_request: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
error.bad_origin: That request came from somewhere else and was refused.
error.bad_content_type: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
error.method_not_allowed: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: That username or password is not right.
error.no_access: This account is not approved for GFTV sites yet.
error.challenge_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
error.no_passkeys: This account has no passkey for this site.
error.passkey_expired: That took too long. Try the passkey again.
error.passkey_failed: The passkey did not work. Try again, or use another way.
error.passkey_exists: This device already has a passkey for this account.
error.telegram_off: Telegram is not available on this site.
error.telegram_not_linked: No Telegram chat is linked to this account.
error.human_check_failed: The are-you-a-person check did not pass. Try again.
error.human_check_pending: Wait for the are-you-a-person check to finish.
error.human_check_unavailable: The are-you-a-person check is not working on our side right now, so this cannot go through. Try again later.
error.last_factor: This is your only second step. Add another one before removing it.
error.not_found: That event is not here any more.
error.rsvp_closed: RSVPs for this event are closed.
error.meal_not_offered: This event does not offer that meal on its own any more. Reload the page and pick again.
error.meal_full: Sorry, one of those meals has no places left. Untick it and try again.
error.volunteers_not_wanted: This event is not taking volunteers. Reload the page and try again.
error.fursuiters_not_asked: This event does not ask about fursuiters. Reload the page and try again.
error.slug_taken: Another event already uses that address.
error.contact_required: The organisers ask how to reach you: fill in the contact details.
error.contact_invalid: Check the contact details: one of them is not written the way it should be.
error.invalid_tier_field: Check this field in ticket tier {number}: {field}.
error.country_required: Pick your country of origin first.
error.invalid_room_field: Check this field in timetable room {number}: {field}.
error.invalid_item_field: Check this field in timetable item {number}: {field}.
error.maps_link_bad: That is not a Google Maps link.
error.maps_link_unreadable: Could not tell where that Google Maps link points. Check it is complete, or fill in the place yourself.
error.maps_lookup_failed: Could not look up that place right now. Try again shortly, or fill it in yourself.
error.manage_only: Only GFTV editors and admins can manage events.
error.admin_only: Only GFTV admins can do this.
error.copy: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
login.staff-note: GFTV staff: set up your authenticator app and reset your password on gftv.asia.
signup.title: Create an account
signup.lede: An account lets you RSVP to events and get notified about them.
signup.username-hint: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
signup.display-hint: Shown to event organisers when you RSVP.
signup.country-hint: Cross-border events and conventions ask for it. Only you and their organisers see it.
signup.email-hint: For signing in. Never shown to anyone.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lede: Reset with a code from your linked Telegram or your confirmed email, with one of your backup codes, or with a reset code from GFTV staff.
reset.code-lede: Pick how to prove it is you.
reset.factor-help: Your account has a second step, so it is needed too.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.lede: Only about events. Nothing else is ever sent.
notify.updates: When an event I am going to changes time or place, changes its timetable, or is cancelled
notify.reminders-legend: Remind me before an event I am going to
notify.reminders-hint: Pick as many as you like, or none. A reminder on Telegram lists every place: the event, the meeting point, and any meal held somewhere else.
notify.new-events: When a new event is announced
notify.push-unavailable: Browser notifications are not set up on this site yet.
notify.push-unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from websites. On an iPhone, add the site to your home screen first.
notify.push-on-here: Notifications are on for this device.
notify.push-off-here: Notifications are off for this device.
notify.telegram: Also send these to my linked Telegram chat
security.lede-staff: Ways to get past the second step when you sign in here. Your password is managed on gftv.asia.
security.lede-public: A second step is optional for your account, but it keeps it safe if your password leaks.
account.delete-lede: Removes your account, your RSVPs and your notification settings for good.
account.delete-confirm: This cannot be undone. Type your password to delete your account.
manage.hint.cover: The cover is cut from a gallery picture: choose "Use as cover" on one below, then pick the 16:9 part to show. Event cards show it as their thumbnail.
manage.hint.cover-save-first: Pictures can be added once the event has saved.
manage.crop-lede-tall: This picture is not landscape, so only part of it fits the 16:9 cover. It starts on the middle; move and zoom to choose the part to show.
manage.crop-lede-narrow: Covers are 16:9, so the top and bottom of this picture are cut. It starts on the middle; move and zoom to choose the part to show.
manage.crop-lede-wide: Covers are 16:9. It starts on the middle; move and zoom to choose the part to show, or use it as it is.
manage.crop-frame: Cover picture as it will be cropped
manage.crop-help: Drag the picture, or use the arrow keys, to move it. Zoom with the slider, the mouse wheel, a pinch, or the + and - keys. 0 goes back to the middle.
manage.crop-banner: The whole frame shows on event cards; the shaded strips at the top and bottom are left out of the wider banner on the event page, so keep faces and text between the dashed lines.
manage.hint.gallery: Add as many pictures as you like, up to 100. Each keeps its own shape, uncropped; your browser shrinks it into a small WebP before it is uploaded. The event page shows them under the description.
manage.hint.gallery-paste: Or copy a picture and paste it here with Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac).
editor.style: Paragraph style (Ctrl+Alt+1, 2, 3 for headings, Ctrl+Alt+0 for normal text)
editor.size: Font size in points (Ctrl+Shift+> bigger, Ctrl+Shift+< smaller)
editor.link-invalid: Enter a web address (https://…), an email address, or a phone number.
editor.paste-lines: The pasted text has lines in it:
editor.pictures-save-first: Pictures can be added once the event has saved.
editor.pictures-not-copied.one: {count} picture could not be copied into the gallery and was left out.
editor.pictures-not-copied.other: {count} pictures could not be copied into the gallery and were left out.
editor.picker-gallery-lede: Choose a picture to put in where the cursor is. You can drag it elsewhere in the text afterwards.
editor.picker-gallery-empty: The gallery has no pictures yet. Upload some below.
editor.crop-frame: The part of the picture to show
editor.crop-help: Drag the frame to move it, and its edges or corners to resize it. On the keyboard: the arrow keys move it (Shift for bigger steps), + and - resize it, 0 takes the whole picture. Only this place in the description changes; the gallery keeps the whole picture.
emoji.load-failed: The emoji could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
stickers.title: Telegram sticker packs
stickers.lede: Add a pack from its t.me/addstickers link to put its stickers in event descriptions. Still stickers are kept as WebP and video stickers as WebM (with a still picture for Safari); animated stickers are left out.
stickers.adding: Copying the stickers from Telegram… This can take a minute for a big pack.
stickers.none: No sticker packs yet. Paste a t.me/addstickers link above.
error.staff_needs_2fa: Set up an authenticator app on your GFTV account at gftv.asia first.
error.username_invalid: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
error.username_reserved: That username uses a word kept for GFTV staff. Pick another.
error.email_invalid: That email address does not look right.
error.email_taken: An account with that email already exists. Try signing in.
error.display_name_invalid: Type a display name of up to 60 characters.
error.password_long: That password is too long. Use at most 72 bytes (about 72 letters).
error.password_weak: Pick a password that is harder to guess.
error.terms_required: Agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy to continue.
error.totp_exists: An authenticator app is already set up.
error.staff_account: Staff accounts are managed on gftv.asia.
error.cover_invalid: That picture could not be read. Try another one.
error.cover_not_webp: The picture must be a WebP. Try again in Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
error.cover_browser_no_webp: This browser cannot make WebP pictures. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox to upload a cover.
error.cover_too_large: That picture is too large even after compressing. Try a smaller one.
error.cover_too_big: That picture is too big. Use one at most 2400 pixels on each side.
error.cover_too_small: That picture is too small. Use one at least 320 by 180 pixels.
error.gallery_too_small: That picture is too small. Use one at least 320 pixels on its longer side and 100 on its shorter side.
error.gallery_full: The gallery is full: an event can have up to 100 pictures. Remove one to add another.
error.gallery_image_gone: That picture is no longer in the gallery. Reload the page and try again.
error.gallery_too_small_for_cover: That picture is too narrow to be a 16:9 cover. Choose a wider one.
error.sticker_pack_link: That is not a sticker pack link. Use one like https://t.me/addstickers/PackName.
error.sticker_pack_exists: That pack is already on your account.
error.sticker_pack_limit: You have the most sticker packs an account can have (30). Remove one to add another.
error.sticker_pack_not_found: Telegram has no sticker pack by that name.
error.sticker_pack_empty: None of that pack's stickers could be copied (animated stickers are left out).
error.sticker_still_size: That still picture is not the size of the sticker.
error.stickers_unavailable: Sticker packs cannot be added right now: the site's Telegram bot is not set up.
error.picture_address_refused: That picture's address cannot be used.
error.picture_not_image: That address is not a picture.
error.picture_fetch_failed: That picture could not be fetched from its website.
error.push_off: Browser notifications are not set up on this site yet.
error.push_invalid: This browser gave an unusable notification address.
error.push_service_unknown: This browser's notification service is not supported.
error.push_too_many: Notifications are on for too many devices. Turn some off first.
error.push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
error.push_unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from websites.
error.push_no_worker: The page is still starting up. Try again in a moment.
reset.ask-staff: This account has no linked Telegram, no confirmed email and no 2FA, so ask GFTV staff for a reset code. They will check it is you first.
reset.done-lede: Sign in with your new password and your second step.
reset.not-found-or-staff: We could not start a reset for that account. If you are GFTV staff, reset your password on gftv.asia.
error.display_name_reserved: That display name uses a word kept for GFTV staff. Pick another.
error.account_not_found: No member account has that username.
admin.filter-lede: Words public accounts may not use in a username or display name. Matching ignores case, spacing, accents, look-alike letters and numbers used as letters.
admin.flagged-lede: Names chosen before a word was listed are kept, and shown here.
admin.reset-lede: For a member with no linked Telegram and no 2FA. Check it is really them first. The code is shown once, works once, and lasts 24 hours; they type it at events.globalfurry.tv/reset.
admin.reset-expires: Shown only now. Works once, until {until}.
tour.hint: Tap ? on any page to see its tour again.
tour.home.when: Upcoming events, ones whose dates are still to come, or past ones.
tour.home.kind: Narrow it down to furmeets, conventions or everything else.
tour.home.feed: Open an event for the details, who is going, and to RSVP.
tour.home.sign-in: Sign in to RSVP and get reminders before an event.
tour.home.account: Your RSVPs, notifications and sign-in settings are under Account.
tour.home.manage: You can make and change events under Manage.
tour.event.preview: Only editors can see this page for now: it is a draft, or its release time has not come yet.
tour.event.facts: When, where, the price and how many are going. Some events show the street address only to people going.
tour.event.sign-in: Sign in to RSVP. You can then get reminders and updates about this event.
tour.event.country: This is a cross-border event, so it needs your country of origin before you RSVP. Only you and its organisers see it.
tour.event.meals: Only coming for a meal? Pick that here and tick which ones. Meals have places of their own.
tour.event.volunteer: Want to help out? Tick this when you RSVP. The organisers mark who really volunteered.
tour.event.rsvp: RSVP here. If your plans change, the same button takes it back.
tour.event.timetable: What happens when. Switch between the table and a list, and pick a day. Times are in the event's own time zone.
tour.event.manage: You can edit this event: this opens it on the Manage page.
tour.account.sign-out-others: Signed in on a shared or borrowed device? Sign out everywhere else from here.
tour.account.tab-going: My events: everything you are going to, each with your RSVP ID, or your ticket tier and number.
tour.account.tab-notifications: Notifications: reminders, and word when an event changes, here or on Telegram.
tour.account.tab-security: Security: passkeys, two-step sign-in, email codes, Telegram and backup codes.
tour.account.tab-profile: Profile: your country of origin and display name. A dot on a tab means something there needs adding.
tour.account.going-list: Events you RSVP to show up here. Open one to change your meals or take your RSVP back.
tour.account.going-past: Events that are over move down to Past events.
tour.account.notify-updates: Hear when an event you are going to changes time, place or timetable, or is cancelled.
tour.account.notify-reminders: Pick as many reminder times as you like, or none.
tour.account.notify-device: Notifications are set for each device: turn them on on every phone or computer you want them on.
tour.account.notify-telegram: Get the same messages on Telegram, once it is linked under Security.
tour.account.security-totp: An authenticator app gives you a six digit code to type each time you sign in.
tour.account.security-passkey: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
tour.account.security-telegram: Link Telegram for sign-in codes and notifications, and to reset a forgotten password.
tour.account.security-backup: Backup codes get you in if you lose your phone. Each works once, so keep them somewhere safe.
tour.account.security-email: Confirm your email to get codes by email: a backup second step once you have an authenticator app or a passkey, and a way to reset a forgotten password.
tour.account.profile-name: Change the name shown for you.
tour.account.profile-delete: Deleting your account removes it, your RSVPs and your notification settings for good.
tour.manage.tab-events: Event list: every event, drafts and ones not released yet included.
tour.manage.tab-editor: Manage event: the form for the event you open.
tour.manage.tab-idreviews: ID reviews: HelloID checks that need an admin to decide.
tour.manage.tab-tuning: HelloID tuning: where HelloID's thresholds should sit, worked out from its own checks.
tour.manage.tab-filter: Name filter: words nobody may use in a username or display name.
tour.manage.tab-reset: Password resets: a one-time code for a member who cannot reset it themselves.
tour.manage.new: Start a new event. It saves once it has a title, both descriptions and a start date.
tour.manage.list-status: Its status. Drafts, and events whose release time has not come, are seen by editors only.
tour.manage.list-edit: Edit opens the event in the Manage event tab.
tour.manage.list-empty: No events yet. Start one with New event.
tour.manage.list-pages: More events are on the next pages.
tour.editor.sections: The form comes in sections. A dot on a tab means a field there needs checking.
tour.editor.autosave: There is no Save button: each change saves when you leave the field. Watch here for Saving, All changes saved, or why a change was refused.
tour.editor.view: See the event page the way visitors will.
tour.editor.delete: Delete cannot be undone. It offers Set to Cancelled instead, which keeps the RSVP list and tells the people going.
tour.editor.price-contact: Need a way to reach the people going? Ask for a phone number, Telegram or Discord, or a field of your own. Only editors see what they give, on the attendee list.
tour.editor.basics-status: Draft, Published or Cancelled: whether the event is live, always here at the top. Calling it off? Set it to Cancelled rather than deleting it: the people going are told.
tour.editor.basics-release: Until the release time, only editors can see the event.
tour.editor.basics-slug: The event's address, /e/ and this link. Left blank, it is made from the title. Change it after sharing and the old link stops working.
tour.editor.basics-cross-border: A cross-border event asks everyone for their country of origin before they RSVP.
tour.editor.basics-descriptions: Both descriptions are needed, English and Chinese. Switch between them here.
tour.editor.basics-cover: Add pictures to the gallery (choose or paste them), then pick one with "Use as cover" and crop it. Keep faces and text between the dashed lines: the event page's banner leaves out the top and bottom.
tour.editor.when-zone: Every date and time on this tab is in this time zone.
tour.editor.when-tba: Dates not settled yet? Tick this to keep them off the public page.
tour.editor.when-locations: Add a place. Pasting a Google Maps link fills it in.
tour.editor.when-private: Keep the street addresses and map links for people going only.
tour.editor.price-tiers: Selling tickets in tiers? The From and Up to prices then come from the tiers.
tour.editor.price-payment: How people pay: on the day, by a payment link, or by scanning your QR code. Turn on as many as you take.
tour.editor.price-capacity: Spaces count people coming to the whole event. People coming just for a meal do not take one.
tour.editor.price-volunteers: Conventions only: take volunteer sign-ups, and give a benefit to people who volunteered at an earlier one.
tour.editor.meals-pick: Tick a meal to let people RSVP just for it. Each can have its own number of places.
tour.editor.meals-elsewhere: Held somewhere else gives a meal a place of its own, like dinner at a restaurant after the meet.
tour.editor.meals-more: Name up to five more, like high tea.
tour.editor.timetable-view: Show the timetable as an itinerary, or as a table with a column for each room.
tour.editor.timetable-rooms: Rooms are the table's columns. A meet in one place needs none.
tour.editor.timetable-items: Add each item on the programme. People going are told when it changes.
tour.editor.people-notes: Staff notes are seen by editors only, never on the public page.
tour.editor.people-list: Who is going, with their RSVP IDs and meals.
tour.editor.people-payments: Payments waiting to be checked. Look at each proof, then tick Paid.
tour.editor.people-volunteers: Signing up is not volunteering: tick Volunteered next to the people who really did.
tour.tools.filter-add: Add your own. Matching ignores case, spacing, accents and look-alike letters.
tour.tools.filter-flagged: Names that already match are listed here to follow up. They are not changed.
tour.tools.reset-check: Check it is really them before making a code: whoever has it can set a new password.
tour.tools.reset-code: The code shows only once and lasts 24 hours. Give it to them alone, to type at /reset.
event.payment-awaiting: Your place is held. Pay to finish getting your ticket.
event.payment-submitted: Payment sent. The organisers will check it.
event.payment-cancel-confirm: You have paid, or said you have, for this ticket. Taking back your RSVP does not refund it: ask the organisers about that. Take it back anyway?
checkout.discount-note: You volunteered at an earlier convention, so your benefit is taken off.
checkout.method-hint.onsite: RSVP now and pay when you arrive.
checkout.method-hint.link: Pay on the organisers' payment page, then tell them here.
checkout.method-hint.qr: Scan the organisers' QR code with your banking app, then tell them here.
checkout.reserve-onsite: RSVP and pay on the day
checkout.reserve-note: Your place is held as soon as you reserve it. You then pay, and tell the organisers.
checkout.reserve-note-onsite: You are going as soon as you RSVP. Bring the amount on the day.
checkout.closed-no-payment: This event does not take payment online. RSVP on the event page.
checkout.closed-closed: This event is not taking RSVPs.
checkout.already-going: You are already going to this event.
checkout.status-awaiting: Your place is held. Pay, then tell the organisers below.
checkout.status-submitted: Payment sent. The organisers will check it, and you will hear when it is confirmed.
checkout.status-paid: Paid. Your ticket is confirmed. See you there.
checkout.status-onsite: You are going. Pay on the day.
checkout.qr-help: Scan this with your banking or payment app.
checkout.reference-hint: The transaction or reference number your bank or app shows.
checkout.proof-hint: Needed, so the organisers can see you have paid. Only they see it, and it is deleted if you take back your RSVP.
manage.payment-not-paid: Set Price to Paid to choose how people pay.
manage.payment-lede: Tick every way you take. With a payment link or QR code, people get a ticket on a checkout page: it holds their place, and they tell you when they have paid. You then tick Paid on the attendee list.
manage.payment.onsite: Pay on the day: a plain RSVP, no payment page
manage.payment.link: Payment link: a page to pay on, such as PayPal or Stripe
manage.payment.qr: QR code: a picture people scan to pay, such as PayNow
manage.hint.payment-qr-save-first: A QR code can be added once the event has saved.
manage.hint.payment-qr: Any shape works, uncropped. It is kept as sharp as it came, up to 1200 pixels on its longest side.
manage.hint.paymentInstructions: Shown with the link or QR code, such as "Put your RSVP ID in the reference".
manage.payment-problem.not_paid: Payment links and QR codes are for paid events.
manage.payment-problem.no_single_price: Payment by link or QR code needs one price to pay: leave Up to blank, or sell tickets in tiers. Until then only Pay on the day is offered.
manage.payment-problem.no_link: Paste the payment link to offer it.
manage.payment-problem.no_qr: Upload the QR code to offer it.
error.tier_changed: The tickets changed while you were choosing. Look at them again and pick one.
error.tier_quantity: One of the tickets cannot be bought that many times. Look at how many you picked.
error.tiers_not_together: These tickets are paid for in different ways, so they cannot be bought together. Pick tickets that can be paid for the same way.
error.payment_unavailable: This ticket cannot be bought online right now.
error.payment_reference_required: Type the payment reference your bank or app shows.
error.payment_reference_invalid: That payment reference is too long. Keep it to 120 characters.
error.payment_proof_required: Add a screenshot of your payment, so the organisers can see you have paid.
error.payment_not_online: There is no payment to report for this ticket.
error.not_going: You do not have a ticket for this event yet.
error.proof_invalid: That screenshot could not be read. Try another picture.
error.proof_too_large: That screenshot is too big. Try a smaller one.
error.proof_size: That picture is too small to read.
error.proof_webp_unsupported: This browser cannot prepare the screenshot. Try another browser.
error.qr_invalid: That QR code could not be read. Try another picture.
error.qr_too_large: That QR code picture is too big. Try a smaller one.
error.qr_size: That QR code picture is too small, or too large, to use.
tour.event.checkout: This event takes payment online: get your ticket here, pick how to pay, and your place is held.
tour.event.payment: Where your payment stands. Come back here to finish paying or see it.
tour.checkout.ticket: Pick your ticket. Any volunteer benefit is already taken off.
tour.checkout.method: Pick how you will pay. A link or QR code holds your place as soon as you reserve it.
tour.checkout.order: What you will pay, before you commit.
tour.checkout.status: Where your payment stands. The organisers confirm it once they have checked.
tour.checkout.pay: Pay here, with the link or by scanning the QR code.
tour.checkout.report: Then tell the organisers: the payment reference, and a screenshot if you like. Only they see it.
tour.checkout.switch: Changed your mind? Pay another way, until the payment is confirmed.
notify.test-sent-telegram: Test sent to your Telegram chat.
error.telegram_send_failed: The test could not be sent to Telegram. Check the bot is not blocked, then try again.
manage.list-empty-status.published: No published events. Drafts are under Drafts until their status is set to Published.
tour.manage.list-filter: Published, Drafts and Cancelled each have their own list. The number says how many.
home.search-placeholder: Search by name, place or organiser
home.search-empty: Nothing found for "{search}". Try Dates to come or Past, or other words.
tour.home.search: Search by name, place or organiser, within the events picked below.
manage.lepak-not-paid: For a paid event: set Price to Paid to use this.
manage.field.lepakEnabled: Let people come without paying, to hang out ("Just Lepak Only")
manage.hint.lepak: They are going like anyone else (address, RSVP ID, reminders) but take none of the event's spaces. They can tick meals too.
error.lepak_full: There are no places left for that.
error.lepak_not_offered: This event does not take RSVPs without a ticket.
tour.event.lepak: Not buying a ticket? Come just to hang out. It takes no ticket, and you can tick meals too.
tour.editor.price-lepak: Let people come without a ticket, to hang out. Rename the choice, and cap how many it takes.
manage.field.tierPayment: Ways to pay for this tier
manage.hint.tierPayment: None ticked: the event's ways to pay, in the Payment section below.
manage.field.tierPaymentMethods: Ways to pay for this tier
manage.field.tierPaymentLink: This tier's payment link (blank for the event's)
manage.hint.tierPaymentQr: None: the event's QR code. A QR code can be added once the tier has saved.
manage.payment-problem.tier-no_link: paste a payment link for this tier, or the event's, to offer it.
manage.payment-problem.tier-no_qr: upload a QR code for this tier, or the event's, to offer it.
error.tier_not_saved: Save this tier first: fill in its name and price, then try again.
manage.editors-lede: People you add here can edit this event and manage its attendees, but cannot publish, cancel or delete it. They need two-step sign-in (an authenticator app or a passkey) turned on before it works.
manage.editor-no-match: No account matches. Check the spelling.
manage.editors-none: No editors of this event yet. Staff editors and admins can edit it anyway.
manage.editors-save-first: Editors can be added once the event has saved.
manage.editor-needs-two-step: Two-step sign-in is off: they cannot edit until they turn it on.
manage.hint.status-staff-only: GFTV staff decide when this event goes live: the Status and release time are theirs to change.
error.editor_not_found: No active account with that username can be added. Start typing and pick one from the list.
tour.editor.editors-add: Let someone else edit just this event, such as its organiser. Pick from accounts active in the last 30 days.
tour.editor.editors-list: They can edit and manage attendees, but not publish or delete. A warning shows until they turn on two-step sign-in.
signup.staff-note-title: GFTV staff: you already have an account.
signup.staff-note: Check that you do not already have a staff account on gftv.asia before making one here. Sign in with it instead: a second account would split your RSVPs and settings.
signup.staff-note-link: Sign in with my gftv.asia account
account.personal-lede: Filled in here once, so registration forms never ask you to type them again. Only you see them, and the organisers of an event whose form asks for them.
account.legal-name-hint: As on your ID, for events that check it at the door.
account.personal-locked: Greyed-out details are set and locked. To correct one, ask GFTV staff.
account.personal-needed: An event you are registering for needs your {details}. Fill it in below, then press Update details.
admin.personal-lede: A legal name, date of birth or country of origin is locked once someone sets it. Check it is really them first, then correct it here, or leave the new value blank to clear it so they can fill it in again. It is in the audit log.
manage.registration-lede: Questions people answer when they get a ticket, such as a badge name and T-shirt size. Each question can be asked of every tier, or only of some. People can change their answers until RSVPs close or their tier closes. Only this event's editors see them, on the attendee list.
manage.registration-account-hint: From the person's account: they fill it in once on their Profile tab, and editors see it on the attendee list.
manage.registration-full-date: Editors see the full date (otherwise only the age at the event, and whether they are under 18)
manage.registration-options-hint: One per line, at least two.
manage.registration-conduct-link: Link to the Code of Conduct
manage.registration-donation-hint: It is added to the ticket's total at checkout.
manage.registration-tiers-hint: None ticked: asked of every tier. A tier that includes a ticked one is asked too.
manage.registration-tiers-gone: The tiers this question was for have been removed, so nobody is asked it. Tick a tier to ask it again.
manage.hint.tierClosesLocal: After this, the tier is not sold, and people holding it can no longer change their registration answers or upgrade from it. Blank: it stays open until RSVPs close.
registration.preset.nfcUrl: NFC website URL on con badge
registration.preset.guardian: I will be accompanying a minor.
registration.hint.nfcUrl: An embedded link for your badge. It must start with "https://".
registration.hint.handlers: Leave blank if you are not suiting, or have no handler.
registration.hint.badgePhoto: Your character, as it should print on your badge.
registration.conduct-required: Tick that you accept the Code of Conduct.
registration.invalid.url: {field}: give a full address starting with https://.
registration.invalid.amount: {field}: give an amount such as 10 or 12.50.
registration.invalid.other: {field}: this answer is not one the form takes.
registration.account-missing: This event needs some details from your account. Fill them in on your Profile tab, then come back.
registration.private: Only the organisers of this event see your answers.
registration.answers-missing: The organisers have added questions since you registered. Answer them below with the pencils.
registration.closed-note: Registration has closed, so these can no longer be changed.
registration.upgrade-lede: Move up from {tier}. What you have paid so far counts: you pay only the difference.
error.account_details_required: This event needs some details from your account first. Fill them in on your Profile tab.
error.registration_closed: Registration has closed, so this can no longer be changed.
error.registration_required: Answer every required question in the registration form.
error.registration_invalid: One of the registration answers is not one the form takes.
error.personal_locked: That detail is locked once set. Ask GFTV staff to correct it.
error.legal_name_invalid: Give your legal name, up to 100 characters.
error.date_of_birth_invalid: Give a real date of birth, not in the future.
error.emergency_name_invalid: Give the emergency contact's name, up to 100 characters.
error.emergency_phone_invalid: Give the emergency contact's number: 6 to 15 digits.
error.tier_closed: That tier has closed. Pick another one.
error.tiers_currency_mixed: These tickets are in different currencies, so they cannot be paid for together.
error.upgrade_currency: You can only upgrade to a tier in the same currency as your ticket.
error.tier_full: Sorry, one of those tiers has sold out. Pick another one.
error.upgrade_unavailable: That upgrade is not available. Reload the page and try again.
error.payment_pending_check: Your payment is waiting for the organisers to check it. You can upgrade once it is confirmed.
error.photo_invalid: That picture could not be read. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
error.photo_too_large: That photo is too large, even made smaller. Try another one.
error.photo_size: That photo is too small. It needs to be at least 64 pixels on each side.
error.photo_webp_unsupported: This browser cannot make WebP pictures. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or a recent Safari.
account.personal-lock-note: Your legal name, date of birth and country of origin are locked once saved: check them before you press Update details.
tour.event.registration-form: The organisers' registration questions. Answer them, then press I am going. You can change your answers afterwards.
tour.event.registration-account: These come from your account, so you never type them twice. Anything missing is filled in on your Profile tab.
tour.event.registration-photo: Pick a photo and it uploads straight away. Only the organisers see it.
tour.event.registration-card: Your registration: your badge name, and the tier you hold.
tour.event.registration-badge: Your badge number. Give it at the door.
tour.event.registration-edit: Tap a pencil to change an answer. You can until RSVPs close or your tier closes.
tour.event.registration-upgrade: Want a higher tier? Upgrade here and pay only the difference.
tour.checkout.registration: The organisers' registration questions go with your ticket. You can change your answers later from the event page.
tour.checkout.registration-donation: A donation is added to your order's total.
tour.checkout.upgrade-pick: Move up to a higher tier. What you have paid already counts towards it.
tour.checkout.upgrade-pay: Your order then waits for the difference. Pay it, then tell the organisers as before.
tour.account.personal-name: Your legal name and date of birth, for events whose registration form asks. You fill them in once, here.
tour.account.personal-locked: Your legal name, date of birth and country lock once saved. If one is wrong, GFTV staff can correct it.
tour.account.personal-emergency: An emergency contact, for events that ask. You can change it any time.
tour.account.profile-idcheck: Some events ask you to verify your ID before you RSVP. Verify once here, with HelloID (GFTV's own, and free) or another way, and it counts for every event that accepts that way.
tour.account.profile-stickers: Telegram sticker packs are for putting stickers in event descriptions. This is optional: if you do not plan to organise events, you can leave it alone.
tour.editor.registration-on: A registration form: what people answer when they get a ticket to a paid event. Setting Kind to Convention switches it on.
tour.editor.registration-tiers: Not every tier gets everything: tick the tiers a question is for, such as a T-shirt size for the tiers that come with a shirt. None ticked asks every tier.
tour.editor.registration-presets: Tick the ready-made questions to ask, and whether each is required. Legal name, date of birth and emergency contact come from people's accounts.
tour.editor.registration-own: Add questions of your own: text, a list, Yes or No, a tick box or a photo.
tour.editor.registration-tier-closes: Each tier can close on its own. After that it is not sold, and the people holding it can no longer change their answers or upgrade.
tour.tools.personal-fix: A legal name, date of birth or country locks once set. Check it is really them, then correct it here. Leave it blank to clear it.
manage.organiser-chats-lede: The bot tells these Telegram chats about each new attendee, once they have given every detail this event asks for (with their contact details), and about each payment once it is confirmed. Add a person's chat ID, or a group's (it starts with -). To get it, send /chatid to the bot in that chat: add the bot to a group first, and a person must press Start in the bot once.
manage.hint.organiserChats: Up to 10, separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
manage.organiser-chats-unreached: Could not reach: {chats}. Check that the bot is in the group, or that the person pressed Start in the bot.
error.chat_id_invalid: "{value}" is not a Telegram chat ID. Use the number /chatid gives: a person's, or a group's, which starts with -.
error.no_chats: Save at least one chat first.
idcheck.title: ID verification
idcheck.lede: Some events ask people to verify their ID before they RSVP. Verify once here and it counts for every event that accepts the way you used. Your verified legal name and date of birth are then locked.
idcheck.options-hint: HelloID is GFTV's own check. Didit and Veriff are outside services, which only some events accept. Check which ways the event you are going to accepts.
idcheck.helloid-pending: Your HelloID check is waiting for GFTV's admins. Events that accept HelloID take your RSVP meanwhile.
idcheck.helloid-declined: Your HelloID check was not approved: {reason} You can try again.
idcheck.document-used: This ID has already verified another account. One person can verify one account only.
idcheck.provider-started: You started a check with {provider} but did not finish it yet.
idcheck.provider-pending: Your check with {provider} is not finished yet.
idcheck.provider-review: {provider} is still reviewing your check. It can take a while.
idcheck.provider-failed: Your check with {provider} did not pass. You can try again.
event.idcheck-needed: This event asks for an ID check before you RSVP. It accepts: {ways}.
helloid.document-lede: Use your original, valid ID. Photocopies and photos of a screen are not accepted.
helloid.already: Your ID is already verified with HelloID.
helloid.waiting: Your last HelloID check is waiting for GFTV's admins. Starting again replaces it.
helloid.consent-photos: You take a photo of your ID, and a short video check of your face: turn your head when asked, while the screen flashes colours. Find good light and hold your phone at arm's length.
helloid.consent-checks: GFTV's server checks the ID, that your face is live and matches the ID, and your device and connection. Nothing is sent to anyone else.
helloid.consent-keep: The photos are deleted as soon as the check is decided. If it passes, GFTV keeps a face template (numbers, not a picture) and a code made from your document's number, only so the same person cannot verify another account. They are deleted with your account.
helloid.consent-review: If the checks are not sure, GFTV's admins look at the photos to decide.
helloid.consent-agree: I agree to HelloID checking my ID this way
helloid.brightness-tip: Turn your screen brightness all the way up before you start. The face check flashes colours on your screen and watches them light up your face: a brighter screen makes it much more likely to pass.
helloid.capture-hint: Lay it flat in good light, fill the frame, and keep every corner in view. No glare on the photo.
helloid.capture-hint-mrz: Lay it flat in good light and fill the frame. Make sure the lines of letters and <<< at the bottom are sharp: HelloID reads them.
helloid.camera-blocked: The camera could not open. Allow the camera for this site in your browser's settings, or use the camera app instead.
helloid.details-account: These are the legal name and date of birth on your account. They must match your ID.
helloid.details-read: This is what HelloID read from your ID. Check it, and correct it if a letter is wrong.
helloid.details-type: Type your legal name and date of birth exactly as they are on your ID.
helloid.details-lock: Once your ID is verified, these become your locked legal name and date of birth.
helloid.details-needed: Fill in your legal name and date of birth.
helloid.live-lede: Fit your face in the oval and follow the prompts. Keep the phone still: move your head, not the phone.
helloid.retake-lede: HelloID could not read the lines of letters and <<< at the bottom of your ID clearly. Take the photo again:
helloid.retake-flat: Lay the ID flat on a plain, dark surface.
helloid.retake-light: Use bright, even light, and tilt the ID or phone until there is no glare or shine on it.
helloid.retake-close: Hold the phone straight above it, close enough to fill the frame, and wait for it to focus.
helloid.brightness-confirm: My screen brightness is turned all the way up
helloid.face-cover-tip: Take off hats, caps and other headwear, and your glasses unless your ID photo shows you wearing them. Never wear sunglasses. A religious head covering can stay on if your ID photo shows it, with your whole face in view.
helloid.retry-flashes.one: The colour check did not pass. Turn your screen brightness up as far as it goes (turn off auto-brightness and battery saver if you can), hold the phone a little closer, keep out of strong light, and try the face check again. {count} more try before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-flashes.other: The colour check did not pass. Turn your screen brightness up as far as it goes (turn off auto-brightness and battery saver if you can), hold the phone a little closer, keep out of strong light, and try the face check again. {count} more tries before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-turns.one: The head turns did not pass. Keep your face in the oval and turn your head further each way when asked, then back to the middle, with your screen brightness up. {count} more try before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-turns.other: The head turns did not pass. Keep your face in the oval and turn your head further each way when asked, then back to the middle, with your screen brightness up. {count} more tries before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-face.one: HelloID did not see just your face the whole time. Keep only your face in the oval, in good light, with your screen brightness all the way up, and hold the phone still. {count} more try before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-face.other: HelloID did not see just your face the whole time. Keep only your face in the oval, in good light, with your screen brightness all the way up, and hold the phone still. {count} more tries before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-match.one: Your face did not match your ID photo closely enough. Take off any hat or headwear, and your glasses if your ID photo shows you without them (a religious head covering can stay if your ID photo shows it); face the screen in good, even light, and try the face check again. {count} more try before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.retry-match.other: Your face did not match your ID photo closely enough. Take off any hat or headwear, and your glasses if your ID photo shows you without them (a religious head covering can stay if your ID photo shows it); face the screen in good, even light, and try the face check again. {count} more tries before it goes to GFTV's admins.
helloid.prompt-left: Turn your head to your left
helloid.prompt-right: Turn your head to your right
helloid.prompt-flash: Hold still and look at the screen: it will flash colours
helloid.sending: Sending your photos and checking them. This can take up to a minute.
helloid.offline: Your photos are kept on this page. They will be sent as soon as the connection is back.
helloid.failed: The check could not be done. {reason}
helloid.approved: HelloID has verified your ID. Events that accept HelloID now take your RSVP.
helloid.review: HelloID could not clear every check on its own, so GFTV's admins will look at it. You will be told when it is decided. Events that accept HelloID take your RSVP meanwhile.
pass.title: Your pass
pass.checkin-hint: Show this at the door. It is saved on this device, so it works with no connection.
pass.entry-alt: Your entry QR code from the organisers
pass.entry-hint: From the organisers. Saved on this device too.
pass.entry-unpaid: The organisers' entry code shows once your payment is confirmed.
pass.entry-later: The organisers' entry code shows from {time}.
pass.entry-checkin: The organisers' entry code shows once you are checked in.
pass.entry-none_left: The organisers have no entry code left for you yet. Ask them at the door.
pass.offline: No connection. This is the pass saved on this device.
pass.offline-show: No connection to check you in. Show your check-in QR code to an organiser instead.
pass.self-done: You are checked in. Enjoy the event!
pass.not-going: This is the event's check-in code, but you are not going to this event.
checkin.offline: Offline: check-ins are kept on this device
checkin.camera-blocked: The camera could not open. Allow the camera for this site in your browser's settings.
checkin.not-on-device: Not on this device's list, and there is no connection to look them up.
checkin.beacon-lede: While self check-in is on, show this QR code at the entrance. People going scan it with their phone's camera, which opens the event page and checks them in. It changes every 30 seconds, so a photo of it soon stops working, and it keeps changing with no connection.
checkin.door-lede: Hold their ID next to them. Check the photo, and that the name and date of birth match.
checkin.clear-hint: This device keeps the attendee list so check-in works with no connection, until a day after the event. Clear it when you are done.
checkin.clear-waiting: {count} check-ins have not been sent yet and will be lost. Clear anyway?
manage.idcheck-lede: Tick the ID checks this event accepts. People must pass one of them before they can RSVP; someone already going keeps their place. Each person checks once, on their account page, and it counts for every event that accepts that check. Leave all unticked for no ID check.
manage.hint.idway-helloid: GFTV's own check, and the only free one. A photo of their ID, a live face check (turning their head while the screen flashes colours) matched to the ID, and the device and connection. A passport fills in the name by itself. Checks that cannot clear go to GFTV's admins.
manage.hint.idway-didit: An outside provider. Each check costs GFTV money, so pick it only when the event needs it, such as reading a passport's chip.
manage.hint.idway-veriff: An outside provider. Each check costs GFTV money.
manage.idcheck-paid-note: Didit and Veriff are paid: every check costs GFTV. HelloID is the only free one.
manage.field.idCheckDoor: Check each person's ID at the door too
manage.hint.idCheckDoor: The check-in page shows their legal name and date of birth, and asks you to tick that you checked their ID before it checks them in. It counts for this event only.
manage.checkin-lede: At the door, open the check-in page on a phone or tablet: scan each person's QR code from their event page, or type their RSVP ID or username. Once it has opened it keeps working with no connection, and sends the check-ins when the connection is back. Self check-in shows a QR code people scan to check themselves in.
manage.entry-lede: Your own QR codes for getting in, such as a cinema's tickets or a venue's pass. People going see theirs on the event page, saved on their phone in case the connection drops.
manage.entry-audience.paid: Only people whose payment is confirmed
manage.entry-show.always: As soon as they get it
manage.entry-show.before: From some hours before the start
manage.entry-hint.shared: Everyone who gets it sees this one code. Adding another replaces it.
manage.entry-hint.each: Each person who gets one is handed the next free code, in RSVP order. To hand a code to someone else, type their RSVP ID next to it.
manage.entry-save-first: Save the event first, then add the codes.
manage.entry-assign-label: Hand code {number} to the RSVP ID
admin.idreviews-lede: HelloID checks that could not clear on its own. Compare the ID with the selfie and the details, then approve or decline (with a reason they will see). The photos are deleted once you decide; an approved check keeps only a face template, so the same person cannot verify another account.
admin.idreview-check.samePerson: The same person in every frame
admin.idreview-flag.face_seen_elsewhere: This face looks like one already verified on another account.
admin.idreview-flag.face_seen_elsewhere_: This face looks like the one verified on @{username}.
admin.idreview-flag.device_seen_elsewher: This device already verified another account.
admin.idreview-note.neutral_faces: No single face in the first frame.
admin.idreview-note.id_no_face: No face found on the ID.
admin.idreview-note.mrz_not_found: The machine-readable zone could not be read.
admin.idreview-note.document_without_mrz: This document has no machine-readable zone: check the name and date of birth by eye.
admin.idreview-note.mrz_ambiguous: The passport number was unclear (several readings fit its check digits): compare it with the photo.
admin.idreview-face-tries: Took {count} goes at the face check. Asked again for: {reasons}.
admin.idreview-retry.match: no match with the ID photo (glasses or headwear?)
admin.tuning-lede: Where HelloID's thresholds should sit, worked out from its own decided checks: how approved and declined checks scored, and how alike different people's faces are. Only scores are read, never photos or names. A developer applies a suggestion in helloid.js.
admin.tuning-counts: {auto} approved by the checks, {approved} approved by an admin, {declined} declined by an admin; {templates} face templates. Face model: {model}.
admin.tuning-setting.faceMatch: Face match (ID photo to live face)
admin.tuning-raise-only: The face match is only ever suggested higher, never lower.
admin.tuning-face: Different people's faces: {pairs} pairs compared. A share of {rate} of them pass the face match now, and {pass} of approved checks do.
admin.tuning-lookalikes: {count} pairs of accounts have faces that score above the face match: lookalikes, or one person verified twice.
admin.tuning-score.turnPitch: Weaker up or down turn, degrees
admin.tuning-warning.few_approved: Only {count} approved checks (want {want} or more): too early to change the turn, flash and same-person settings.
admin.tuning-warning.few_pairs: Only {count} pairs of different people (want {want} or more): too early to change the face match.
admin.tuning-warning.few_declined: Only {count} checks declined by an admin (want {want} or more): the declined column means little yet.
admin.tuning-warning.no_frames: No check has kept how alike its frames were yet (kept from now on): the same-person setting cannot be suggested.
error.id_check_required: This event asks for an ID check first.
error.id_provider_unavailable: That ID check is not available here.
error.id_provider_failed: The ID check service did not answer. Try again in a while.
error.helloid_consent_required: Agree to the HelloID check first.
error.helloid_document_invalid: Pick the document you are using.
error.helloid_challenge_expired: The face check took too long. Start the face check again.
error.helloid_pictures_invalid: A photo could not be read. Take it again.
error.helloid_already: Your ID is already verified with HelloID.
error.checkin_code_invalid: That is not a check-in code for this event, or it is too old.
error.checkin_other_event: That check-in code is for another event.
error.self_checkin_off: Self check-in is off. Show your check-in QR code to an organiser.
email.sent: Email sent. Check your inbox, and your spam folder too.
login.help-email: Press Email me a code, then type the code from the email. On this device you can press the button in the email instead.
login.email-link-busy: Signing you in with the link from your email...
error.email_off: Email is not available on this site.
error.email_not_confirmed: This account has no confirmed email address.
error.email_missing: This account has no email address.
error.email_send_failed: The email could not be sent right now. Try another way, or try again later.
error.email_link_expired: That email link has expired or was already used. Start again.
error.email_link_other_browser: Open the email link in the browser where you asked for it, or type the code from the email there.
security.email-note: A backup second step once you have an authenticator app or a passkey, and a way to reset a forgotten password.
security.email-none: Not confirmed. Codes would go to {address}.
security.email-missing: This account has no email address.
security.email-sent: We emailed a code to {address}. Type it here, or press the button in the email.
reset.email-verified: Email confirmed. Now choose a new password.
